youtube.title: What if you were the King's Groom of the Stool?
youtube.description:
Henry VIII's court, 1530s: you carry the king's velvet close stool, hand him the towels – and somehow you're the most powerful man at court. 🚽👑
Would you take this job? A) Yes. Power is power B) Never. Not for a crown C) Only for the purse – Comment A, B or C 👇
Sources: Historic UK (Groom of the Stool), Wikipedia (Groom of the Stool; Privy Chamber), The Tudor Society (Sarah Bryson, "The Groom of the Stool")
